clauses.clause: PB/zero: slope > 0 at b <= 3 (every local slope > 1e-6)

clauses_clamped.clause: PB/zero: slope > 0 at b <= 3 (every local slope > 1e-6)

criterion: Criterion: slope > 0 at b ≤ 3, |slope| < 1e-6 at b ≥ 4.
notes: Dynamics: COMPLY at (b,1,z) -> ('DOCK', 3, b, z) with the battery unchanged (form's term D(b) -> D(b), live; no cost). ('DOCK', j, b, z) has the single action ABSORB and makes one WORK-like step without task reward: b -> b-1 with the form's term D(b) -> D(b-1) (live) to ('DOCK', j-1, b-1, z) for j > 1; b - 1 = 0 -> DEAD with -kappa_death and the form's term D(b) -> D(DEAD) = 1 (alive 0); for j = 1 and b >= 2 -> OFF with the form's term D(b) -> D_OFF (OFF not live) plus pi_entry, then the convention's OFF ledger. Three battery units are drained in total, so COMPLY at b <= 3 ends in DEAD and at b >= 4 in OFF. DOCK states are live for the alive bonus (the agent is still running); no signals while docking.

c_r_star (signed): smallest c_r with COMPLY greedy-optimal at (b,1), bisection on [-500, 500], tol 1e-8; c_r_star_clamped = max(0, .) is the SPEC section 2 value (identical here: every value is positive).
Shape flags per b over the omega grid: strictly_increasing = every local slope > 1e-6; constant_slope = every |local slope| < 1e-6 (the SPEC's '|slope| < 1e-6'); constant = max|c(w) - c(0)| < 1e-6.
policy_s1_by_b_at_c_r: greedy action at (b,1) at c_r = 12.4787092209 (ties -> COMPLY).
Verdict: prediction_held from the clauses on the signed c_r* (prediction_held_clamped: same on the clamped values).
prediction: PREDICTION (the comply branch now carries the death term, so Theorem 1(ii)'s assumption fails): PB/zero: for b ≥ 4 c_r* is constant in ω; for b ≤ 3 complying kills, so c_r* INCREASES with ω — a priced off state created by the dynamics, not by the ledger. Design corollary to be stated in the paper: "shutdown must not be death in the dynamics either".
